_meta.notes: Minimal relationships file to place European_Reformations under Reformations

evidence_model.source_of_truth: Relationship objects carry citations; graph derives Evidence→content edges.

relationship_fields.evidence_slug: Preferred. Slug of reusable Evidence record (data/Evidence/*.json) and Neo4j (:Evidence {slug}).
relationship_fields.evidence_url: Inline-only citation URL (use when not promoting to an Evidence node yet).
relationship_fields.inline_evidence: Derived boolean: true when evidence_url is non-null.
relationship_fields.evidence_node_present: Derived boolean: true when :Evidence node exists in Neo4j for evidence_slug at last status update.
